subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Nova Software
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novasoftware.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novasoftware.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC next steps & initial success criteria — Nova Software

Hi Priya / Liam —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary from call:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Nova's customer support summarization pipeline (2k tokens avg, 10k peak).
- Success criteria (draft): 90% parity vs existing baseline on summary relevancy, sub-150ms 95th percentile generation latency for 1k prompt size, end-to-end cost target <$0.015 per 1k tokens served.
- Scope: 2-week sandbox POC with sample traffic, and a final readout + runbook.

Proposed owners / roles:
- Redwood: Marissa (engagement), Aditya (AE / contract), Vivek (SE/infra + SSO setup)
- Nova: Priya (product lead), Liam (infra / SRE), Sara (data / evals)

Proposed timeline (high-level):
1) Kickoff & environment access — Week of Jul 6 (1-hour)
2) Baseline run & initial tests — Days 1–3
3) Performance tuning & KV caching tests — Days 4–9
4) Weekly check-ins (30m) — Jul 13 & Jul 20
5) Final readout & next-step decision — Jul 23

Deliverables we will produce:
- Success criteria doc (attached)
- POC timeline (shared Drive link below)
- Weekly check-in agenda template

Ask from Nova for kickoff:
- A set of 200 representative conversations (anonymized) + evaluation rubric
- A sandbox AWS account role or short-lived creds we can use to push small test traffic
- Point of contact for SSO and network allowlist

I attached the draft success criteria and will upload a detailed timeline spreadsheet tomorrow. Please reply with any edits to the success criteria and confirm the proposed kickoff window.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: 20260701-nova-poc-success-criteria.docx (Word doc, 2 pages)

Thanks Marissa — this is great, and the timing works for us. A few quick notes from our team after the call: 

- Success criteria: the relevancy metric should be measured against our internal human-rated set (we'll share rubric). The cost target looks reasonable but we may need a relaxed threshold during tuning.
- Data: we'll anonymize 200 conversations and share them by EOD Jul 3; Sara will lead that.
- Access: we can provide a sandbox role for the week of Jul 6; Liam will send role details and allowlist IPs.

Confirming kickoff on Jul 7 at 10:00 AM PT (we prefer Wed the 7th). Can you and Vivek make that time?

Also, can you include an explicit acceptance criteria section in the success doc that calls out the go/no-go decision gates for the final readout?


—Priya

priya.shah@novasoftware.com

- Kickoff: Jul 7, 10:00 AM PT (1h) — agenda attached in Drive doc

- Week 2 (Jul 12–16): tuning, caching, and stability testing; daily short runs + perf profiling
- Weekly check-ins: Jul 13 & Jul 20 (30m)
- Final readout: Jul 23 (1h) — include stakeholders + decision gate

Attachments: 20260703-redwood-poc-timeline.xlsx, redwood-poc-agreement.pdf

Two quick asks for the kickoff meeting so we can come prepared:
1) Confirm who will own the evaluation rubric (Sara?) and who will attend the final readout from Nova (product + SRE + bizops recommended).
2) Provide the sandbox role ARN and any allowlist IPs before Jul 6 so Vivek can confirm network connectivity.
